corrected_claim: Russia-Ukraine escalation was real and markets fell on nuclear-threat headlines in Nov 2024: Ukraine fired US ATACMS into Russia (Nov 19), Putin updated Russia's nuclear doctrine (Nov 19-20), and Russia launched the Oreshnik missile at Ukraine (Nov 21). India's sharpest selloff in that window was Thursday Nov 21, 2024 (Sensex -1,190 pts, Nifty closed below 24,000); on Nov 19-20 Nifty actually closed higher after snapping a 7-day losing streak. The 'Tuesday, >300-point intraday fall, 250 points in the final hour' details as recalled are unreliable.

corrected_claim: In early Aug 2024, US equities fell sharply: Nasdaq composite ~-13% from its July 10-11 record close to the Aug 5 close (intraday peak-to-trough ~-15%, Nasdaq-100 ~-15-17%); Dow fell 1,000+ points. The trigger was NOT strong inflation data - it was the weak July jobs report (Aug 2) plus the Bank of Japan rate hike unwinding the yen carry trade. The 'fresh intraday all-time high then reversal' belongs to mid-July 2024 (cool CPI July 11, rotation).
